title: Can't open dynamic library: Error: dlopen failed: "***.so“ has bad ELF magic: 504b0304.
body:
### Tested versions

Repoduceable on 4.6.offical.stable

### System information

Godot Engine v4.6.stable.official.89cea1439 - Vulkan 1.3.128 - Forward Mobile - Using Device #0: Qualcomm - Adreno (TM) 735

### Issue description

I written a C++ GDExtension that use vcpkg to manage any C++ libs including ffmpeg, godot-cpp etc.. It's work normally on `Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated AMD Radeon (TM) Graphics (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 31.0.21923.11000) - AMD Ryzen 5 7530U with Radeon Graphics (12 threads) - 15.31 GiB memory` device.
But when I build it to android and run on my `Godot Engine v4.6.stable.official.89cea1439 - Vulkan 1.3.128 - Forward Mobile - Using Device #0: Qualcomm - Adreno (TM) 735` Android 16 device, it returns below error:

I use [custom Cmakelists.txt](https://github.com/html5syt/Moonlight-Godot/blob/vcpkg/CmakeLists.txt) and [Github Action workflow](https://github.com/html5syt/Moonlight-Godot/blob/vcpkg/.github/workflows/builds.yml) to build it cross-platform.

Is this promlem caused by engine, ci, vcpkg or other?I feel extremely lost. Who can help me?

ps: the [godot-cpp package from vcpkg](https://vcpkg.io/en/package/godot-cpp) current version is 4.4, and I had opened a new issue [there](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/issues/49723) to let the contributors to update.

if anyone want the ci build logs, I'm glad to give it.

### Steps to reproduce

Open MRP, build project with Gradle.
Install to phone, open it and see the Logcat at the same time.
if click "test http request" and then Logcat return an uuid response from Httpbin, it work normally.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

because the GDExtension is too big, you can get this at [Action's artifact](https://github.com/html5syt/Moonlight-Godot/actions/workflows/builds.yml), download demo project at [https://github.com/html5syt/Moonlight-Godot/tree/vcpkg/demo](https://github.com/html5syt/Moonlight-Godot/tree/vcpkg/demo), and then put the ".so" lib into `demo\addons\moonlight-godot\bin\android` to make the MRP.

PS: choose the artifact after "Build Moonlight GDExtension #165: Commit [f2cd178](https://github.com/html5syt/Moonlight-Godot/commit/f2cd178becf9c948e1ef5fa0bbfbbaa038dab33e) pushed by [html5syt](https://github.com/html5syt)".
